transcript: Fringe hit A Letter to Lyndon B Johnson or God: Whoever Reads This First is running at Soho Playhouse this week and next week, and it is simply brilliant. Based on the title alone, I'm not sure this would have piqued my interest, but everyone who's seen it had great things to say about it, and now having attended, I completely concur. This is a two hander by Xhloe Rice and Natasha Roland about two boy scouts / US soldiers in the LBJ era. It’s a somewhat absurdist but moving portrait of masculinity, vulnerability, friendship, and boyhood — specifically, American boyhood. The performances were great, the staging was delightfully playful, creative, precise, and it broke my heart — which I love. It is a rather dense and fast-paced 60 minutes so you do have to lock in, but it really delivers and the overall way that this is crafted is quite impressive from start to finish. This show is running at Soho Playhouse through February 22nd. With that, another program for my collection.
